{"results": [
  {"n": "G1", "evidence": "Screenshots 1–5 show the 3D scene rendered in Chrome with no blank screen or errors.", "pass": true},
  {"n": "G2", "evidence": "Screenshots 2–5 demonstrate camera orbiting and zooming, and `OrbitControls` restricts `maxPolarAngle = Math.PI * 0.495` and `maxDistance = 300`, keeping the camera above water and inside the 10000-unit sky/water bounds, though right-click panning is left enabled by default.", "pass": true},
  {"n": "G3", "evidence": "The scene uses modest geometry (~230k triangles on terrain, instanced grass, low-poly lighthouse and boulders), one 2048 shadow map, and Three.js planar `Water` reflection at 512x512 with no heavy post-processing, easily running above 30 fps on integrated graphics.", "pass": true},
  {"n": "1", "evidence": "Screenshots 1–5 display a persistent UI text overlay `#controls-hint` ('Left Click: Rotate | Right Click: Pan | Scroll: Zoom') in the bottom-left corner.", "pass": false},
  {"n": "2", "evidence": "In the `animate()` loop, `water.material.uniforms['time'].value += delta * 0.45` runs automatically on load without user input.", "pass": true},
  {"n": "3", "evidence": "In screenshot 1, the camera is positioned much higher looking down onto a steep, narrow snow mound rather than the low-angle view across wide rocky foreground ledges in the reference photo.", "pass": false},
  {"n": "4", "evidence": "In screenshots 1–3, the lighthouse has a tapered white octagonal tower, white gallery, red octagonal lantern room with peaked roof, side vestibule, and dark small windows matching the reference photo's colors and design, though the tower body is overexposed.", "pass": true},
  {"n": "5", "evidence": "In screenshot 1, instead of a rocky shore with exposed boulders and patchy snow as in the photo, the foreground is almost entirely a smooth white snow mound with tiny brown cones and only three isolated grey rocks.", "pass": false},
  {"n": "6", "evidence": "Screenshots 1–3 and 5 show the ocean extending beyond the island to the horizon.", "pass": true},
  {"n": "7", "evidence": "In screenshots 1–3, the sky is nearly solid washed-out white/off-white rather than the rich, clear blue winter sky in the reference photo.", "pass": false},
  {"n": "8", "evidence": "Comparing screenshot 1 with the reference photo, the tower appears noticeably thinner and more elongated (`towerHeight = 11.2`, `bottomRadius = 2.35`, `topRadius = 1.48`) than the sturdier proportions in the photo.", "pass": false},
  {"n": "9", "evidence": "Screenshots 1–3 and the lighthouse build code show a lantern room with transparent glass windows, red mullions, internal lens, and a white octagonal gallery railing.", "pass": true},
  {"n": "10", "evidence": "In screenshots 1–4, the shoreline terrain is a smooth rounded dome with thin dark lines drawn on it, and the scattered boulders are faceted low-poly blobs lacking natural cracks and fissures.", "pass": false},
  {"n": "11", "evidence": "Screenshots 1–3 show the lighthouse base sitting flush on the summit rock without floating or awkward sinking.", "pass": true},
  {"n": "12", "evidence": "Screenshots 1–3 and 5 show the 10000x10000 water plane meeting the horizon cleanly from all orbited angles with no visible geometry edge.", "pass": true},
  {"n": "13", "evidence": "In screenshots 1–4, shadows cast by the boulders and terrain undulations consistently fall toward the right/back-right, matching the single `DirectionalLight`.", "pass": true},
  {"n": "14", "evidence": "In screenshots 1–3, the entire white tower is blown out to nearly uniform flat white, blending into the white sky with almost no discernible shading on its shadow side.", "pass": false},
  {"n": "15", "evidence": "In screenshots 1–3 and 5, there is a sharp, bright blue band right at the horizon between the grey-white water and white sky rather than a smooth atmospheric haze fade.", "pass": false},
  {"n": "16", "evidence": "In screenshot 1, both the sky and the white lighthouse tower are blown out to near-pure white, losing surface and edge contrast.", "pass": false},
  {"n": "17", "evidence": "The lighthouse uses uniform `MeshStandardMaterial` colors (`0xfcfcfc` and `0xb81422`) with no weathering or texture variation, appearing flat and clean in screenshots 1–3.", "pass": false},
  {"n": "18", "evidence": "In screenshots 1–3, the exposed rock near the waterline reads as smooth matte blue-grey plastic with thin dark contour lines rather than wet, dark real stone.", "pass": false},
  {"n": "19", "evidence": "In screenshots 1–3, the lantern glass (`transmission: 0.92`) is clearly see-through, showing the inner Fresnel lens and back mullions while catching subtle sky reflections.", "pass": true},
  {"n": "20", "evidence": "Screenshots 1–5 show Three.js `Water` reflecting the bright sky across the surface as a pale grey mirror, without depth-based color shifts near the shoreline.", "pass": false},
  {"n": "21", "evidence": "Screenshots 1–3 and 5 show a flat, level horizon across the frame.", "pass": true},
  {"n": "22", "evidence": "The ocean is a flat `PlaneGeometry(10000, 10000)` using Three.js `Water`, which only scrolls a normal map (`time` uniform) for ripples rather than rolling 3D waves of varied heights.", "pass": false},
  {"n": "23", "evidence": "Neither the screenshots (2–5) nor the HTML source include any breaking waves, shoreline foam, or particle spray.", "pass": false},
  {"n": "24", "evidence": "There is no foam implemented anywhere in the scene (screenshots 2–5 and source code).", "pass": false},
  {"n": "25", "evidence": "Inspection of the HTML source (`animate()` only updates `water.material.uniforms['time']`) confirms there is no drifting snow, wind-blown spray, or grass motion.", "pass": false},
  {"n": "26", "evidence": "In `animate()`, `water.material.uniforms['time'].value += delta * 0.45` advances the normal map smoothly at a gentle real-world pace without loop jumps.", "pass": true},
  {"n": "27", "evidence": "In screenshots 1–3 and 5, faint grid/tiling streaks are visible on the water surface (especially noticeable in the foreground of screenshot 5 and horizontal banding toward the horizon).", "pass": false},
  {"n": "28", "evidence": "There are no spray particles in the scene (confirmed in screenshots and source code), so the requirement for soft spray particles is not met.", "pass": false},
  {"n": "29", "evidence": "Screenshots 2, 3, and 5 show the flat water plane intersecting the rock geometry in a hard, sharp clipping line with a mirror reflection and zero foam.", "pass": false},
  {"n": "30", "evidence": "Screenshot 1 looks like a basic, overexposed low-poly 3D render with a white sky, smooth snow hill, uniform spiked grass cones, and a UI hint box, bearing little resemblance to a real photograph.", "pass": false}
]}
